items.title_en: The Little-Known Life Of The Rusty-Spotted Cat, The Elusive Predator That Weighs Just Three Pounds
items.title_zh: 锈斑猫鲜为人知的生活，体重仅三磅的难以捉摸的掠食者
items.summary_en: David V. Raju/Wikimedia Commons The rusty-spotted cat is the smallest feline in the world, with a body that’s just 13 to 19 inches long. In the wilderness of India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal lurks a fierce predator, quietly stalking its prey through the region’s jungles and grasslands — but it only weighs three pounds. The rusty-spotted cat may be the smallest wild feline in the world, but it’s built to kill.
items.summary_zh: David V. Raju/Wikimedia Commons 锈斑猫是世界上最小的猫科动物，身体只有 13 到 19 英寸长。在印度、斯里兰卡和尼泊尔的荒野中，潜伏着一种凶猛的掠食者，它在该地区的丛林和草原上悄悄地跟踪猎物——但它的重量只有三磅。锈斑猫可能是世界上最小的野生猫科动物，但它生来就是为了杀人。

items.title_en: ‘Millions know Speed, very few know Darren’: IShowSpeed opens up about loneliness

items.summary_zh: IShowSpeed 表示，有时他醒来时会感到孤独，尽管他取得了一切成就。
